== Objectives ==
Bring the Sealed Kul Tiran Letter to Vice Admiral Renhoff at the Kul Tiran Embassy in the Stormwind Harbor.
* [[Sealed Kul Tiran Letter]] (provided)

==Description==
It has been three hard years since Lord Daelin brought us to these Light-forsaken shores. The strength of our Expeditionary Fleet has been duly tested against the orcs and their miserable allies, while I was able to find little to no resources in my absence.

If I am to win this war, or at the least secure a westward bulwark against our most hated enemy, then I cannot fight alone.

Vice Admiral Renhoff is an old friend of mine, and he holds great sway within Kul Tiras.

I need you to find him in Stormwind and deliver this letter to him, to plead our case, to ensure that all our sacrifices are not in vain.

==Progress==
What is it? Can I help you?

==Completion==
Alverold lives?! Tides be thanked!

With the fall of Lord Daelin, we thought the western cause lost. Indeed, many in Kul Tiras have elected to divert our attention north.

It will not be easy to persuade them to support the Kalimdor Expedition again; it is far more likely that they will demand Alverold's return for his assistance in the northern realms instead.

Still, I will do what I can and send word to Alverold once I have news.

You have Kul Tiras' gratitude, <name>.
